correctness.rationale: Every normal subgroup is obtained from its intersection with the cyclic index-two subgroup. The resulting presentations exhaust and separate the quotient types. Intra-branch embedding is divisibility; unique-involution and four-torsion arguments exclude cross-branch embeddings, except C2 into the dicyclic branch. All joins and the precise meet-failure set follow. CHECK.py verifies the complete relation on \(2\le m\le12\) without serving as the infinite proof.

value.rationale: This is the natural full classification of a named infinite family explicitly used as a nonlattice example in the new QIso literature. It computes all comparabilities, proves join existence and quantifies missing meets. Same-order dihedral groups have the same number of quotient classes but a distributive lattice, showing an order-theoretic difference invisible to counting.
